title: 第154章 挑战成功
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黄垒在五个水果的选项中思考。

苹果、西瓜、葡萄、榴莲、芒果。

“最不可能的……”

黄垒沉吟片刻，“应该是葡萄吧？葡萄又酸又小，洪雷这个人应该最不喜欢这种小家子气的东西。”

“2、1！”

黄垒不再犹豫：“我选葡萄！”

门外的走廊上，倒计时结束。

吴凡的声音响起：“时间到！朝哥、洪雷哥，你们的选择是什么？”

邓朝率先开口，笑得一脸灿烂：“我选择的是榴莲！”

话音刚落，孙洪雷瞪大了眼睛，满脸惊喜地看着邓朝。

“巧了！”孙洪雷一拍大腿，“我选择的也是榴莲！”

两个人对视了一秒，然后同时伸出右手在空中击了一掌。

“啪”的一声脆响，在走廊里回荡。

邓朝咧嘴笑道：“咱们这是心有灵犀啊！”

孙洪雷顿时点头：“想到一起去了，简直太默契了啊！你说咱俩要是在一个队，那还得了？”

门内陈鹤听到这段对话，整个人都不好了。

“邓朝你个猪！！！”

陈鹤的声音从门内传出来，几乎是吼的，“你没事选什么榴莲啊！”

邓朝非但不生气，反而理直气壮地冲着门喊道：“榴莲咋了？榴莲多好吃啊？我最爱吃榴莲了！”

“这个问题是让你选择吃什么吗！”

陈鹤的声音里透着绝望，“是看默契啊！默契有没有！”

邓朝转头看向孙洪雷，一脸无辜：“你看他不懂我，还是咱俩心有灵犀，是吧洪雷哥？”

孙洪雷笑得前仰后合，拍着邓朝的肩膀：“没错没错，虽然咱俩不是一个队的，但是我觉得咱俩做队友也不是不行，肯定比你们的天霸更厉害！”

邓朝点头，“我也这么觉得！”

旁边的摄像机完美捕捉到了这一幕，跟拍导演已经在憋笑了。

陈鹤则是一脸黑线。

旁边的黄垒也没比陈鹤好到哪去。

黄垒在听到孙洪雷选了榴莲后，一只手捂住了额头：“洪雷你在干什么？这么简单的题目，你能不能动动脑子啊！”

孙洪雷听到黄垒的喊声，一脸困惑地挠了挠头：“我选榴莲，是因为我觉得你会选榴莲啊！”

黄垒对着镜头，欲哭无泪：“这个傻子，你看我说了吧，他就想不到西瓜！还在那儿我喜欢吃榴莲呢，我看他都忘了自己演过刘华强了吧？”

走廊上，吴凡的声音再次响起，这次带着一丝忍俊不禁的笑意：

“恭喜你们第一次挑战失败，现在马上开始第二轮，也是这扇门的最后一次机会。”

门内的陈鹤和黄垒同时着急了起来。

陈鹤的声音从201室传出来，语速飞快：“朝！你忘了我们录制五哈的时候，我创的那个答题公式了吗？就按照那个来！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Huang Lei was thinking among the five fruit options.

Apple, watermelon, grape, durian, mango.

"The most unlikely..."

Huang Lei pondered for a moment, "It should be grapes, right? Grapes are sour and small. Hong Lei probably dislikes such petty things."

"2, 1!"

Huang Lei no longer hesitated: "I choose grapes!"

In the corridor outside the door, the countdown ends.

Wu Fan's voice sounded: "Time's up! Brother Chao, Brother Honglei, what is your choice?"

Deng Chao was the first to speak, with a bright smile: "I choose durian!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Sun Honglei's eyes widened and he looked at Deng Chao with surprise on his face.

"What a coincidence!" Sun Honglei slapped his thigh, "I also chose durian!"

The two looked at each other for a second, then simultaneously stretched out their right hands and slapped each other in the air.

A crisp sound of "pop" echoed in the corridor.

Deng Chao grinned and said, "We have a clear understanding of each other!"

Sun Honglei nodded immediately: "I thought we would go together. It's such a tacit understanding! Do you think it would be okay if we were in the same team?"

Chen He inside the door felt bad after hearing this conversation.

"Deng Chao, you are a pig!!!"

Chen He's voice came from inside the door, almost shouting, "What durian do you want to choose?"

Instead of being angry, Deng Chao confidently shouted at the door: "What's wrong with the durian? How delicious is the durian? I love durian the most!"

"Does this question ask you to choose what to eat?"

Chen He's voice was full of despair, "It depends on the tacit understanding! Is there a tacit understanding?"

Deng Chao turned to look at Sun Honglei with an innocent look on his face: "You think he doesn't understand me, but we still have a good understanding, right, Brother Honglei?"

Sun Honglei burst into laughter and patted Deng Chao on the shoulder: "That's right, that's right, although we are not on the same team, I think we can be teammates. We will definitely be more powerful than your Tianba!"

Deng Chao nodded, "I think so too!"

The camera nearby captured this scene perfectly, and the director following the scene was already suppressing a smile.

Chen He had a dark look on his face.

Huang Lei next to him was no better than Chen He.

After Huang Lei heard that Sun Honglei chose durian, he covered his forehead with one hand: "Hong Lei, what are you doing? Can you use your brain for such a simple question?"

When Sun Honglei heard Huang Lei's shout, he scratched his head in confusion: "I chose durian because I thought you would choose durian!"

Huang Lei faced the camera, almost crying: "This fool, you see what I said, he can't think of watermelon! I still like to eat durian over there. I think he has forgotten that he played Liu Huaqiang, right?"

In the corridor, Wu Fan's voice sounded again, this time with a hint of laughter:

"Congratulations on your failure in the first challenge. Now the second round will begin, which is also the last chance for this door."

Chen He and Huang Lei inside the door became anxious at the same time.

Chen He's voice came from Room 201, speaking very fast: "Chao! Have you forgotten the answer formula I created when we recorded Wu Ha? Just follow that!"
